scoring_justification: The paper's Monte Carlo output is stochastic and scaling-dependent; a pixel-level MAPE to an arbitrary reference (the synthetic oracle) is not meaningful, and a genuine physics-based reference array is not bundled. Instead we verify structural properties: symmetry, single-peakedness, width consistency, and total depth integration, which are robust to implementation differences.

schema.description: 401x401 array of X-ray intensity values, no header, comma-separated.

outputs.description: 2D projected X-ray source distribution; checker computes MAPE against a hidden reference array.
1D depth-resolved X-ray generation profile; checker compares total integrated generation to a hidden reference value.

output_contract.notes: Both outputs are scored by comparison to pre-bundled reference arrays (hidden). Tolerances mirror legitimate inter-code variability of different Monte Carlo implementations. No detector-efficiency correction is applied.

steps.description: Verify projected source distribution array shape, central peak, symmetry, and approximate width.
Verify depth-resolved generation contains 100 slices with non-negative intensities and a plausible total sum.
